source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 6Comic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceGamesPikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyReleases 11/12/26Select a versionNintendo Switch 2Nintendo SwitchUpgrade PackWhat's an upgrade pack?Select an editionPhysical - Pikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyComic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceQuantity1LoadingFind retailersNintendo Switch 2 features• Enhance your expedition with improved visuals for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.• Sharpen your command of Pikmin in a series of exams at Dandori Academy.• Give voice commands to Oatchi, your dependable space dog, using the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone.• Challenge your friends in Dandori Battles, even if they don’t have the game, via GameShare** locally or online via GameChat.Nintendo Treehouse Plays: Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyWatch Nintendo Treehouse play Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy as they team up with Pikmin and good pup Oatchi to go for the best scores on three difficulty levels of Dandori Exams. The highest difficulty exam features an Empress Bulblax!Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition!Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with creatures multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. The fate of your Pikmin is yours to decide!Create and customize your own pint-sized explorer and traverse a world that is teeming with life—and visually enhanced with high-resolution graphics for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!Enroll at Dandori AcademyDandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and sometimes explorers like to get in on some friendly competition. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game features Dandori Academy*, an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time—and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.Battle with your budsWhen you’re ready to take on your fellow explorers in Dandori Battles, you can do so with a friend on the same system†. You can even get them in on the fun via GameShare‡ locally or online via GameChat—even if they don’t have the game!Who’s an even gooder boy?!Dependable partner Oatchi has learned a new trick: he can now listen for your voice commands via the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone as you play! (Don’t be shy about telling him how good he is.)Enjoy enhanced visualsDelight in sharper detail with improved high-resolution visuals in both TV mode and handheld mode.Experience it all on Nintendo Switch 2This game is the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. It includes the Nintendo Switch game plus the upgrade pack, which adds more features and enhancements for play on Nintendo Switch 2.Get the full gameAlready have the Pikmin 4 game?Get just the upgrade pack to enhance your game for play on Nintendo Switch 2!Get the upgrade pack* Full version of the Pikmin 4 game required to use this content. Sold separately. For details, visit support.nintendo.com/switch2/upgradepack† Additional games, systems and/or accessories may be required for multiplayer mode. Games, systems and some accessories sold separately.‡ Nintendo Switch 2 system must initiate GameShare session. Users who receive software via GameShare can only play the software during the session in which it was shared. Shared game will not be playable after the session ends. Nintendo Switch 2 and GameChat required for each user engaging in GameShare via GameChat. Internet, Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features, including GameChat. Not available in all countries. Terms and GameChat requirements apply. support.nintendo.com© NintendoPublisher notification(s):Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy Coming SoonYou can start playing the Nintendo Switch version today and be ready to play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition at launch by pre-ordering the upgrade pack***.About this itemSupported play modesHandheld modeTV modeTabletop modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-2)Local wireless (2)Online (2)Nintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. source.title: Where Winds Meet’s climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc revealed, out Nov 13
source.evidenceText: October 27, 2026October 27, 2026 Where Winds Meet’s climactic Hutuo Battlefield narrative arc revealed, out Nov 13 1 0 35 Like this When empires crumble and all hope seems lost in the blood-soaked mud, what keeps you fighting? Eric Zheng Head of Where Winds Meet Publishing Today, we are proud to unveil the most climactic narrative arc in Where Winds Meet yet: Hutuo, a sprawling new region launching November 13 alongside the game’s first global anniversary update. Marking a major turning point in Where Winds Meet, Hutuo invites you onto an epic, war-torn frontier to experience a story of unwavering conviction, camaraderie, and the true meaning of heroism. Play Video Defining ‘Xia’: From martial arts to universal heroism When we first set out to build Where Winds Meet, our aspiration was to reimagine Wuxia—a genre long confined mostly to classic cinema—as a living, breathing Jianghu for a global audience. Nothing has moved us more than seeing wanderers worldwide find their own resonance within this realm: discovering what ‘Xia’ truly means through personal awakening, sacred promises, and the enduring longing for freedom. We reached an unforgettable milestone this August when the game welcomed over 100 million players worldwide and claimed Best Mobile Game at Gamescom. Being the first to bring an authentic Wuxia open world to the global stage has been a deeply humbling journey, proving that the spirit of this genre speaks to hearts across every border. Yet our vision goes beyond combat choreography and ancient traditions. With Hutuo, we wanted to delve deeper into the spiritual core of ‘Xia’ (Chivalry)—exploring how sacrifice and guardianship reflect a universal heroism that resonates across all cultures. Nowhere is this clearer than in the story we tell at the battle of Zhongdu Bridge. Here, you step into a desperate historical crossroads: northern invaders are surging across the border, frontline defenses are fracturing, and old pacts lie in ruins. With displaced civilians behind you and an unstoppable tide of steel ahead, loyalty and justice pull in opposite directions. A haunting question arises: when the powers above fail, do you fight in blind obedience to a crumbling throne, or rise alongside sworn companions to shield the innocent and guard your homeland? How you answer that call captures what we believe is the truest, most profound essence of ‘Xia’. The Hutuo Battlefield: Uncovering light in the ashes To anchor this theme, we shifted our world design to craft an authentic, mud-and-steel warzone unlike anything seen in the game before. We focused heavily on immersive environmental storytelling and quest design, allowing players to experience the wartime Jianghu from varied perspectives. Whether stepping into the shoes of a conflicted soldier defying brutal orders, listening to a haunting song of displaced survivors among the river reeds, or witnessing nameless folk risk their lives to shelter refugees in the night, each tale captures a distinct facet of the frontier. Even in the darkest corners of history, we wanted these intimate stories to uncover the enduring light of ordinary lives, showcasing the quiet dignity and everyday bravery of people surviving the storm of war. Immersive warfare: PS5 & PS5 Pro enhancements To make every clash across this frontier feel immediate and visceral, we have tailored dedicated technical upgrades for PlayStation players: PS5 Pro & enhanced PSSR: Utilizing enhanced PSSR alongside upgraded ray-traced reflections, Hutuo’s rivers and wetlands look more striking than ever at a stable 60 FPS, bringing fire and falling ash vividly to life across uneven, mud-soaked reflections beneath your feet. Tactile combat & responsiveness: DualSense adaptive triggers and haptics lend physical weight to every drawn war-bow and clashing blade, while reduced frame hitches during effects-heavy battles keep your parries, combos, and dodges razor-sharp. Seamless battlefield scale: Optimized asynchronous asset streaming drastically cuts load times across fast-travel points, dungeons, and cinematic transitions—ensuring your charge into Hutuo’s core warzones remains smooth and uninterrupted. Yuen Woo-ping’s dual spears & a historic first anniversary Experiencing the emotional peak of Where Winds Meet goes hand-in-hand with our biggest celebration yet. Arriving November 13, our first anniversary update delivers the most generous historic rewards since launch, alongside fun and tactical new board game modes like Horse Racing Chess and Jianghu Tactics. The celebration continues on late November with the debut of the Dual Spears Martial Art. Directed and choreographed by legendary action director Yuen Woo-ping (Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon), this dynamic style alternates fluidly between offensive Light Spears and stance-breaking Heavy Spears, building Spear Stance for relentless combo loops. Want an early look at the front lines? Tune in to our First Anniversary Special Broadcast on November 2, where our team will share deeper developer insights and exclusive gameplay reveals for Hutuo.
